caption: The drawing depicts a metal hand-crank grinder mounted on a rectangular piece of light brown wood, oriented horizontally. The grinder has a dark gray, trapezoidal hopper on top with a hinged lid that is open, revealing the interior of the hopper. Below the hopper, the main body of the grinder is round and metallic, colored in shades of gray and dark brown, with two mounting screws securing it to the wood. Extending from the right side of the grinder is a black metal crank handle, which bends downward and then outward, ending in an oval-shaped, light brown wooden grip. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the artist's name "FRANK H. ADAMS" is written in small capitals on the lower right part of the drawing.
title: Coffee Mill
